comparison.objective: Move hazards away from a toddler and a sippy cup toward them, requiring semantic routing and handovers; not tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Cross-workspace bimanual handovers, differentiated transport, and orientation preservation versus localized tool insertion and rotary calibration.
comparison.success_condition: Hazards wholly beyond a 550 mm divider; cup within 150 mm; knife flat and other items upright. Exact orientation tolerances are missing. Candidate evaluates stopping dynamics and lock integrity.
comparison.reason: Semantic hazard sorting and handover coordination are meaningfully different.
